title: Photo Evidence Missing-Room Coverage
dataSources: Schedules (`reno:gantt`), punch lists (`reno:punchlist`), photo logs (`reno:photo`), permits (`reno:permit`), project controls (`reno:ops`).
app: Home-renovation project telemetry — Gantt plans, punch-list updates, inspection photo logs, and permit expiry trackers — streamed to Splunk HEC via builder-tool exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reno:photo room=* evidence_complete=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(evidence_complete="no",1,0))) as matched by room
| eval missing_evidence_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - missing_evidence_pct
description: Measures the percentage of inspection photo sets that end with missing evidence by room.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which room are helping or hurting inspection photo sets.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `missing evidence` on `reno:photo` events and summarize the hit rate by `room`.
visualization: Table of room with percentage of inspection photo sets ending with missing evidence.
grandmaExplanation: It totals how often missing evidence happens for each room so you can see where inspection photo sets go smoothly or get stuck.
